missions.title: A cheat at archery
missions.kicker: River Market · A cheat at archery
missions.button: There's an archery contest outside the gate

a.text: Outside the gate young men shoot at a straw target for a prize of five coins. You see Mundhir's friend nudge the target closer each time Mundhir shoots.

speak.text: The judge moves the target back to its mark and makes everyone shoot again. Mundhir comes third. He doesn't speak to you.

shoot.text: You shoot as straight as you can and miss twice. Mundhir wins - with help. You know, and he knows you know.

spoke: Called out a cheat at the archery
the young men at the gate
